locations.name: Mayflower Sanctuary
locations.description: The project world itself. Further world details remain to be confirmed.

locations.name: Muse Harbor
locations.description: A luminous creative and AI waterfront with gardens, digital waterways, creator studios, community plazas, performance stages, and an innovation district. It is the home setting of YOUTHSPARK_Muse.

locations.name: Music Performance Stages
locations.description: A performance-stage district within Muse Harbor.

locations.name: Rose Sanctuary
locations.description: A location inside Mayflower Sanctuary: a partially collapsed Gothic Cathedral Ruin with a Rose Window, Angel Statues, Cloister Gardens, Bell Tower, and Crypt. Its visual direction includes a luminous celestial palace, crystal gardens, waterfalls, moonlight, and a huge Earth in the sky.

notes: Location IDs match the existing schematic map marker keys; the map is not to scale.
